collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks a young adult and a child aged 5-10)

collection.description: A young villager teaching children for the first time is asked if fish have feelings: answer about fish, or get back to the fruit.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has always wanted to teach. Today (subject.he/she) has gathered a few children under a tree to show them how to tell a ripe fruit from an unripe one. (subject.He/she) has planned it carefully. Five minutes in, one child is asleep, one is eating the examples, and (friend) has put up (friend.his/her) hand to ask if fish have feelings.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (subject) abandons the fruit and talks about fish instead. What they eat, how they breathe, whether they have feelings \("nobody's quite sure"\). The children are spellbound. Nobody learns anything about fruit. (subject) walks home thinking it was a complete disaster and the best afternoon (subject.he/she) has had in years.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: "Good question," says (subject). "Let's ask it after the fruit." The children groan. (subject) presses on. By the end, two of them can tell ripe from unripe, and (friend) has asked about fish four more times. (subject) promises a fish lesson tomorrow. (subject.He/she) spends the whole evening preparing for it.
